name: Data360 Beast Phase Coverage Matrix
purpose: Machine-readable view of source, proof, helper, and frontier coverage by Data 360 phase. This complements docs/phase-proof-matrix.json, which owns routing and proof expectations.

coverageLevels.strong: Public docs and specialist guidance exist, plus proof ledger or helper coverage.
coverageLevels.documented: Official-doc or OpenAPI-backed guidance exists, but target-org proof still depends on implementation.
coverageLevels.frontier: Design guidance exists, but live proof should be generated in Beast Labs before promotion.
coverageLevels.lab-required: Scenario-rich proof belongs in data360beast-labs before core guidance should be raised.
